svg.title: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol: complete teaching sequence

g.title: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: PhCH2OH + Cr(VI) → PhCH2O–Cr(VI) ester. Ligand exchange and proton transfer generate a chromate ester.

g.text: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol · 1
Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Ligand exchange and proton transfer generate a chromate ester.

g.title: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: PhCH2O–Cr(VI) + base → PhCHO + reduced chromium species. Base-assisted carbonyl formation cleaves O–Cr; the chromium redox network is grouped.

g.text: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol · 2
Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Base-assisted carbonyl formation cleaves O–Cr; the chromium redox network is grouped.

g.title: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: PhCHO + H2O / acid → PhCH(OH)2. Carbonyl protonation, water addition and deprotonation establish the gem-diol equilibrium. These are grouped, not a new measured elementary event.

g.text: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol · 3
Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Carbonyl protonation, water addition and deprotonation establish the gem-diol equilibrium. These are grouped, not a new measured

g.title: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: PhCH(OH)2 + Cr(VI) → PhCH(OH)O–Cr(VI) ester. A hydrate hydroxyl forms another chromate ester.

g.text: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol · 4
Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
A hydrate hydroxyl forms another chromate ester.

g.title: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: Hydrate chromate ester + base → PhCO2H + reduced chromium species. Removal of the remaining carbon H forms the acid carbonyl. Further chromium disproportionation/speciation is not assigned unique SORG digits.

g.text: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol · 5
Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Removal of the remaining carbon H forms the acid carbonyl. Further chromium disproportionation/speciation is not assigned unique
